solutions.title: Manual parser with clamping
solutions.strategy: Skip leading spaces, read an optional sign, accumulate digits, and clamp as soon as the 32-bit range is exceeded.

timeComplexity.explanation: At most the leading spaces, sign, and digit prefix are scanned.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only index, sign, and accumulated value are stored.

solutions.title: State machine parser
solutions.strategy: Model whitespace, sign, digit, and stop states explicitly while reusing the same overflow guard.

timeComplexity.explanation: The parser advances through the string prefix once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The machine stores a constant number of state variables.
